gadgets.sink: render(controller('Class::method', {args})) instantiates an arbitrary no-argument class and calls a method on it
gadgets.effect: turns template control into arbitrary file write, chmod and delete without any exec function. controller() builds a ControllerReference, render() resolves it through the controller resolver, and the map entries bind to method parameters BY NAME.
gadgets.precondition: template injection or any other control over Twig source in an app whose Twig environment is the application's own, so the Symfony extensions are registered. The target class must have a no-argument constructor.
gadgets.trap: Twig 3.12 and later refuse a string where a filter wants a callable, so the usual ['cmd']|map('system') family is dead and this is the replacement. Fingerprint first with constant('Twig\\Environment::VERSION') rather than cycling payloads. Symfony\Component\Process is useless alongside it when proc_open is in disable_functions.
